title: DAY 5 - Rehab & Recovery
author: J B.
desc: Single day program meant to act as an addition or supplement to many existing 4-5 day strength and hypertrophy programs.

ss.note: Go up in weight as much as tolerated

Slow eccentric 3 seconds,
UP with 2 legs, 
DOWN with 1 leg,
As heavy as tolerated
Slow eccentric 3 seconds, progress as tolerated.
Hopping on the spot (warmup).
Try to stay in one spot with accurate movements.

ss.n: SL pogos side to side over line (each leg)
ss.note: Try to be as symmetrical as possible
Jump up on a slightly challenging height, then try to land as softly as possible (without making a sound).

Set 1 Feet Straight
Set 2 Feet Out
Set 3 Feet In
